advices.diagnosis: The class is tiny (NOM=4, WMC=4) but its cohesion is poor (LCOM4=2) because it mixes presentation logic with domain‑infrastructure concerns (OrderRepository and EmailClient). It also shows a feature‑envy pattern (many accesses to Customer) and violates the presentation layer rule by directly importing infra components, flagged by LV‑SKIP violations.

suggestions.title: Extract a ReportService to the application layer
notes: addresses_smells names labels the target does not carry: feature_envy, layer_violation

advices.risk_notes: Moving repository and mailer calls into a new service introduces an extra class and may increase DCC (more distinct internal types referenced). Existing code that instantiates ReportView will need to be updated to provide a ReportService, which could break runtime wiring if dependency injection is not adjusted. The change also adds a thin delegation layer, so performance impact is negligible but test suites must be updated to mock the new service.
